title: Chat
selectConversation: Select a conversation to start chatting
selectConversationHint: Pick a conversation on the left, or start a new one.
noPeople: No one available to chat with
noPeopleHint: Once more people join, they'll show up here.
deleteMessageHint: This removes the message for everyone in the conversation.
newConversationHint: Pick one person for a direct message, or add several to start a group.
noConversationsHint: Start a direct message or spin up a group to get the conversation going.
creator: Owner
leaveGroupHint: You'll stop receiving messages from this group. You can be added back later.
leaveChatHint: The other person keeps the history, but the chat is deleted after 48 hours unless they re-invite you and you re-join.
deleteGroupHint: This permanently deletes the group and all its messages for everyone. This can't be undone.
noMedia: No photos or files shared yet
noMessagesHint: Say hi to {name} and get the conversation started.
noMessagesGroupHint: Be the first to post in {name}.
messageNotLoaded: That message is further back — load older messages to see it
rejoinPrompt: You've been invited to re-join a chat.
conversationDeletedHint: It no longer exists — this can happen once a group is deleted or an abandoned chat is purged.
conversationNotFound: You don't have access to this conversation
conversationNotFoundHint: You may have left it, been removed, or the link is out of date.
